title: Cryptographic Role Coverage Matrix
matrix_policy: Each row declares cryptographic primitives, key formats, providers, and verification status across all three baselines. Hybrid roles strictly require Accept_hybrid = Verify_C(m, sigma_C, PK_C) AND Verify_Q(m, sigma_Q, PK_Q). Classical fallback in hybrid roles is prohibited.

roles.producer_consumer: Every TLS peer pair (TPP <-> AS/DAS, Wallet <-> DAS, TPP <-> RS)
roles.requirement_hybrid: Negotiate approved hybrid group/parameters; fail closed on downgrade when policy requires hybrid.
